statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and palpitations
The patient has known atrial fibrillation
The patient has atherosclerotic heart disease
The service was ordered to correlate intermittent symptoms with underlying arrhythmias
The service was ordered to assess the efficacy of current rate control management
The diagnosis codes I48.91, I25.10, and R55 are documented
The claim was denied with reason code PR-204
The denial is based on the service not being covered under the member's current benefit plan
